findings.reason: §6 must either add the resume/lane-change call sites and a second measure to its mechanism and write paths, or declare resume out of scope, and its own thesis ("refuses rather than degrades") cannot hold while a resumed figure review degrades.
findings.text: §6 names one dispatch call site (`reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1578`) as where images reach `launch_plan`, but `launch_plan` is also called by `resume_plan` (`reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:1108`) and `change_lane` (`reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:1538`), neither of which passes `images`; a figure-review run that stalls mid-turn and is resumed — the normal recovery path on this workstation — composes an argv with no `-i` and the lane answers from the filename and the diff, which is exactly the silent wrong verdict §6 exists to prevent

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — reckon/crew/node.py (`TaskNode` at :699) and reckon/crew/dispatch.py (the `_backends.launch_plan(` call at :1578) and reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py all resolve; tests/test_dispatch_attaches_the_figures.py is the section's own new deliverable.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §6's done-when names a measurable outcome (both `-i` flags in the argv the launcher would run, the clive refusal naming the lane, an added-failure delta against base) and declares a negative control ("drops the images at the dispatch call, and the two-flag case must then fail").
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §6's gate is "logged under the run directory", a durable per-run path a later reader can open, not a scratchpad.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §6 introduces no plan labels, ticket numbers or version tags into symbols; `images`, `--image PATH` and `declared_input_modalities` name mechanisms.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §6 threads a node's figures through only one of the four production `launch_plan` call sites, leaving the resume and lane-change callers composing an argv with no `images`, so a resumed figure review silently drops its figure.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §6 carries one deliverable: a node's figures reach the composed command line (TaskNode.images, the dispatch pass-through, and the `--image` CLI seam that feeds it).
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §6 occupies its declared place between landed §2 and §7/§8 in the sequencing prose (§5 comment "The order now", §6 "§7's delivery probe and §8's evaluation use it"), and it depends on nothing pending: the codex argv composition it drives landed in §2.
